leads.kind: Potential genuine synonym/input coverage in the physical clock-instrument sense

forms.not_independent_synonyms: Plural is an inflection; further case/article forms require grammar review, not alias-volume credit.

Clock/watch/device subtypes and digital versus mechanical use require exact semantic screening.
leads.likely_player_benefit: If independently supported, recognize a plausible currently unavailable typed clock guess while preserving the existing Ceas owner.
leads.next_action: Acquire exact primary semantic sense evidence and independent qualified-owner/recognition review; keep held until then.

leads.kind: Sourced shared denotation with narrower clock/register cautions
leads.supported: Official DOOM provides lemma and plural/article morphology; primary linguistics study explicitly places it in time-instrument denotative synonymy.
leads.unresolved: Classroom context describes a large fixed clock and flags possible unfamiliarity. Broad unqualified interchangeability with every clock/watch and average Romanian recognition are unproven.

forms.not_independent_synonyms: Article/plural forms are morphological inputs, not separate synonym families.

counterexamples: Orologiu for an architectural clock may be narrower than generic Ceas or a wristwatch.
The time-instrument overlap does not license mapping it to Oră, Minut or Secundă.
leads.likely_player_benefit: Possible optional typed input for a familiar displayed owner, if the subtype/sense review supports that treatment; no rare-word display or new target approval proposed.
leads.next_action: Keep the qualification and recognition hold; verify primary dictionary senses and intended optional-input scope before selecting anything.
